requested_command: set -e; echo before_active=$(systemctl --user is-active kylin-memory.service || true); systemctl --user stop kylin-memory.service; systemctl --user disable kylin-memory.service; pkill -f "runtime/python/bin/python -m embedding.server --socket /tmp/kylin-d14a-embed.sock" || true; rm -f "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/kylin-memory/memory.sock" /tmp/kylin-d14a-embed.sock; sleep 1; echo after_active=$(systemctl --user is-active kylin-memory.service || true); echo embedding_processes=$(pgrep -f "runtime/python/bin/python -m embedding.server --socket /tmp/kylin-d14a-embed.sock" | wc -l); echo socket_exists=$(test -S "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/kylin-memory/memory.sock" && echo yes || echo no); echo embed_socket_exists=$(test -S /tmp/kylin-d14a-embed.sock && echo yes || echo no)
